2317-3899-5478-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

2023-3755-4770-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1879-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
1879-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

567-1409-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2034-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-3125-5477.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2738-3220-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Golgari Germination, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

618-3817-3967.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-4029.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1563-2079-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1322-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

104-7399-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-7399-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3875-4231-5184-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6441-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2438-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

141-6798-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

1978-4324-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Workshop Elders.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3053-3488.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-3488.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Katsumasa.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
1879-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2173-3845-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2741-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4188-4824-6287.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Soliton and Accomplished Alchemist are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
4188-4824-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

748-2232-2983-3806.description:
Cast Raka Disciple by paying {0} due to Ragemonger.
When Raka Disciple enters the battlefield, Sethron and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
When the Minotaur token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Raka Disciple to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

678-2882-3819-4050-4221.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2882-3819-4050-4221.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Living Plane and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land, adding one mana of any color.
When the land dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the land to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put the land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1847-2608-3169-4050.description:
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping The Golden Throne.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2633-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control an untapped green creature.
2633-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating two token copies of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {1} and tapping a green creature you control.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

837-1283-2440-3544.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Humans and/or Wizards.
837-1283-2440-3544.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Auramancer to your hand.
Cast Auramancer by paying {3}.
Auramancer enters the battlefield, triggering Auramancer and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Auramancer trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1486-1651-5056.description:
Cause Magda to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat from step 2.
